Name: DE-CompaniesAdditionalInformation
Description: Extracts the custom fields associated with the companies.
Statement:
select  com.Oid as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company,
        cuf.*
from    Company com
            left join Company_UserFields cuf on cuf.Oid = com.Oid
where   (@ModifiedFrom is null or cuf.ModifiedOn >= @ModifiedFrom)
